title: Internal integral direct image preserves completeness and canonical reduction
statement:
theorem internal_integral_direct_image_limits
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) :
    let χ :
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
            AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E U 0 ⟶
          AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X 0 ⋙
            (CondensedRing.upperStar (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E 1) j).mapDerivedCategory :=
      ((mateEquiv
          (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction (AdicCompletion.quotient l E X 0))
          (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction (AdicCompletion.quotient l E U 0))).symm
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
              (CondensedRing.derivedComapUpperStarIso (DerivedNakayama.reductionRing l E 1) j).inv)
          ).natTrans
    ∃ hχ : IsIso χ, letI := hχ; ∀ K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E U),
      (IsDerivedComplete l E U K → IsDerivedComplete l E X
        ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) j).obj
          K)) ∧
      IsIso (((CondensedRing.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
        (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E 1) j).ofNatIsoLeft
          (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
            (DerivedNakayama.quotientRing l E 1) j)).homEquiv _ _
        (inv (χ.app ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
            (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) j).obj K)) ≫
          (AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E U 0).map
            (((CondensedRing.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) j).ofNatIsoLeft
                (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
                  (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) j)).counit.app K)))
All objects and maps use the actual continuous internal coefficient objects; quotient index zero is exponent one.

proof.text: The unit-normalized scalar pullback isomorphism equals the specified inverse mate: apply injectivity of the scalar adjunction Hom bijection and unit_mateEquiv_symm. Hence chi is invertible at every positive finite level.

The scalar cone comparison has identity first two components and third component scalar restriction of the displayed finite projection. The triangle five lemma makes this third component invertible. Exact faithful scalar restriction reflects derived isomorphisms by homology, so the actual finite projection is invertible.

Unpack canonical completeness into its signed Roos triangle using roos_isDerivedLimit and the invertible augmentation. Integral direct image is a triangulated right adjoint and preserves countable products. The finite quotient tower comparison preserves both transition and augmentation. Transport the signed Roos triangle through its product comparison; isDerivedComplete_of_roos gives canonical completeness of the direct image.
